limits: Qopt row correspondence uses source author positional mapping to the 313-ID list, not IDs in the Q files. All K derived from the same already-fitted joint adult+seed genotype model; holdout excludes only adult centroid training labels, not genotype model fitting. Not out-of-sample genetic assignment validation.

Nearest centroid is descriptive resemblance, not a population-of-origin model, not DAPC accuracy. Adult site label is sampled site, not natal origin. Depth and site can overlap in ancestry; nuclear seed ancestry includes both parents.

Fine consensus compares K5/K9 and Euclidean/Hellinger with equal grid-weight centroid; no independent samples, confidence or true dispersal distance. No per-seed DAPC labels available, aggregate comparison only.
